title: Specialist Electronics Devekioment Engineer
description: Shaping tomorrow's technologyAt Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable,innovative, and data‑driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle lifecycle. We support the Volvo Group engineering community with advanced tools, methods, and architectures that enable continuous customer value even after start of production.Our strategy is to accelerate the Software Defined Vehicles journey by using a layered software and electronic architecture with industry‑standard interfaces, enabling faster development and regional adaptation.By decoupling hardware from software, we ensure that software can evolve independently, unlocking flexibility, scalability, and long‑term performance improvements. We align our electrical and software architecture with business and operational models to fully leverage the potential of Software Defined Vehicles.Are you passionate about shaping the future of automotive technology? We are looking for a highly skilled Specialist Electronics Development Engineer to play a key role in the development of advanced automotive electronic systems, including Electronic Control Units (ECUs) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.In this position, you will combine your deep technical expertise with strong leadership and project coordination skills, working closely with Tier 1 suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams. You will be instrumental in driving technical excellence, ensuring robust validation, and delivering high-quality solutions for next-generation vehicle systems.What You Will DoAs a Specialist Electronics Development Engineer, you will:    Lead and support the development of advanced automotive electronic systems, with a focus on ECUs and HPC platforms.    Coordinate development activities across hardware, software, and verification teams to ensure seamless execution.    Collaborate closely with Tier 1 suppliers to align technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables.    Drive validation activities to ensure product quality, robustness, and compliance with automotive standards.    Manage and resolve technical issues using structured methodologies, including root cause analysis, failure investigation, and 8D reporting.    Define, maintain, and follow up on action plans, project risks, and issue resolution activities.    Monitor project progress and provide regular updates on milestones, technical status, and key risks.    Foster strong cross-functional collaboration and ensure clear communication among all stakeholders.    Contribute to continuous improvements in engineering processes, validation methods, and project execution practices.Who You AreYou are a technically strong and structured engineering professional with a passion for automotive electronics and a proven ability to lead complex development activities. You thrive in collaborative environments, confidently manage multiple stakeholders, and enjoy solving challenging technical problems.Required Qualifications    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.    Extensive experience in automotive electronics development.    Proven experience developing ECUs and exposure to High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.    Demonstrated technical leadership experience, including leading engineering teams and technical activities.    Strong understanding of collaboration models with Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs.    Experience in automotive validation and verification activities.    Experience in project management or technical coordination within automotive development programs.    Hands-on experience with:    Action plan management    Failure analysis and root cause investigations    8D problem-solving methodology    Progress tracking and project follow-up    Experience working in cross-functional environments involving hardware, software, and verification teams.    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.    Professional proficiency in English.Preferred Qualifications    Experience managing complex automotive programs involving multiple stakeholders and supplier networks.    Knowledge of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.    Experience with system integration and issue resolution in multidisciplinary environments.    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international engineering organization. Key Competencies    Automotive electronics expertise    Technical leadership    Structured and analytical problem-solving    Cross-functional collaboration    Project planning and execution    Effective communication and stakeholder management    Supplier and customer interface management    Results-driven mindset Why Join Us?This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on cutting-edge automotive technologies and contribute to innovative products that shape the future of mobility. You will work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative, international environment where your expertise, leadership, and ideas will help drive technical excellence and meaningful results.In this role, you will report to the Head of ECU and HWReady to take the next step in your career? We look forward to hearing from you.We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Drifttekniker till datacenter i Boden
description: Är du en person som gillar teknik, både den digitala och den mer handfasta, och tycker det är kul att lära dig nya saker? Trivs du bäst när du jobbar ihop med andra i ett team där alla hjälps åt? Och bor du inom 50 minuter från Boden, eller kan du tänka dig att flytta hit?Då vill vi gärna att du söker jobbet som drifttekniker hos ossVilka är vi?BRS Networks är ett väletablerat företag inom fiber och IT. Vi är cirka 75 medarbetare med huvudkontor i Visby och kontor i Kalmar, Mälardalen och Tyskland. Vi är en Managed Service Provider (MSP). Det betyder att vi tar helhetsansvar för våra kunders IT-miljöer, med tjänster inom datacenter, IT-infrastruktur, drift, support och IT-säkerhet.Hos oss är det prestigelöst och vi har stark laganda. Ingen fråga är för liten, och du har alltid kollegor att vända dig till.Vad ska du göra?Som drifttekniker ser du till att allt fungerar i ett modernt, affärskritiskt datacenter. Dina insatser gör att våra kunder kan lita på hög tillgänglighet och stabil drift. Det är en viktig roll.En vanlig arbetsvecka kan innehålla:Daglig drift av den tekniska infrastrukturen· Övervakning och reparationer. Du håller koll på larm och utrustning, åtgärdar fel och byter ut eller reparerar trasiga komponenter· Drift och underhåll av servrar, nätverk och system· Datacentrets fysiska miljö, alltså kraft, kyla och säkerhet· Skötsel av fastigheten till viss del. Du ser till att byggnaden och dess installationer håller god standard, gör enklare underhåll och tillsyn och är kontaktperson mot leverantörer och entreprenörer när det behövs· Felsökning, incidenter och serviceärenden. Ibland är det lite detektivarbete!· Dokumentation av det du har gjort· Månatlig audit. Varje månad inventerar du alla maskiner och all nätverksutrustning i datacentret, så att vi alltid har koll på vad som finns och var det finnsDu jobbar nära kollegor, teamledare och andra tekniker. Vi ger dig stöd från början, och i takt med att du växer i rollen får du ta större tekniskt ansvar.Det här är viktigt att känna till: beredskapI tjänsten ingår beredskap och den kan även innebära skiftarbete. När du har beredskap ska du kunna vara på plats vid datacentret i Boden inom 50 minuter efter larm. Därför behöver du bo inom 50 minuters resväg från Boden, till exempel i Boden, Luleå eller en närliggande ort. Du kan också flytta hit innan du börjar.Skriv i din ansökan var du bor i dag. Om du planerar att flytta, skriv när du kan vara bosatt i området. Vi kan tyvärr inte behandla ansökningar som saknar den här uppgiften eller där kravet inte uppfylls.Vem är du?Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett. Nyfikenhet och rätt inställning väger tungt hos oss! Det här behöver du ha med dig:· Gymnasieutbildning eller yrkesutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot IT, elektronik eller teknik· Grundläggande tekniska kunskaper och intresse för IT-drift, nätverk och datacenter· Noggrannhet och en lösningsorienterad inställning· Du trivs med att jobba strukturerat i en miljö där säkerhet och kvalitet är avgörande· God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska· B-körkortDet är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av arbete i datacenter eller relevanta certifieringar.Vad får du hos oss?En arbetsplats som präglas av samarbete, ansvar och utvecklingErfarna kollegor som gärna delar med sig av vad de kanChansen att utvecklas både tekniskt och personligtEn inkluderande arbetsmiljö där vi värdesätter mångfald och där alla får möjlighet att växa

title: Senior Product Assurance Manager
description: OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for a wide range of missions - including communications, Earth observation, and space research and exploration- serving both institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Assurance Manager to join the Quality & Product Assurance team at OHB Sweden.In this role, you will lead Product Assurance activities within our space projects, ensuring that quality, reliability and product assurance requirements are effectively implemented throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with engineering, project management, customers and suppliers, with a direct impact on product quality and mission success. Your Role and Responsibilities    Lead and coordinate Product Assurance activities throughout the complete project lifecycle    Define and maintain project Product Assurance plans and ensure compliance with applicable ECSS, customer and company requirements    Act as the main Product Assurance interface towards customers, suppliers and project teams    Support and participate in project reviews, including PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR and acceptance reviews    Manage nonconformances, review boards, root cause investigations and corrective actions    Review and approve PA related documentation, qualification evidence and supplier deliverables    Coordinate Product Assurance disciplines such as EEE, materials and processes, RAMS, software assurance and quality assurance    Perform and support supplier audits, inspections and assessments    Identify product and quality risks and ensure appropriate actions are implemented    Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to other Product Assurance and Quality engineers, consistent with OHB Sweden's senior PA profile.Your Qualifications    University degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field    5 years minimum of experience in Product Assurance or Quality Assurance within the space industry    Good knowledge of ECSS Product Assurance standards    Experience with space hardware development, manufacturing, integration, testing and qualification    Experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis and supplier quality assurance    Ability to understand and review complex technical documentation    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills    Excellent written and spoken EnglishWho Are We Looking For?You are an experienced and pragmatic professional who combines strong technical judgement with a collaborative mindset. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging decisions when necessary and working independently with customers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You bring a risk based and solution-oriented approach to Product Assurance, balancing quality, mission assurance, cost and schedule. The position is based at our office in Kista, Stockholm. Travel may be required, primarily within Europe and occasionally to the USA.

title: IT Security Advisor
description: Want to influence how security is built into IT solutions across a global industrial group? We’re looking for an experienced IT security professional who combines broad technical expertise with sound judgment, helping teams make informed, risk-based decisions throughout the solution lifecycle. We offer you:     Real influence and independence, without people-management responsibility.      Close collaboration with product teams, architects, projects and experienced security specialists.      Exposure to a large, complex environment with an evolving technical scope.  About your job As IT Security Advisor, you provide independent, risk-based guidance and assurance across a broad range of technologies and business solutions. Working closely with stakeholders, you identify relevant requirements and risks, challenge designs when needed and turn complex security matters into clear, practical recommendations. Job responsibilities     Guide product owners, system owners, architects and projects on solution design, security requirements and potential risks.     Conduct independent IT Security Reviews, documenting findings, risk rationale and recommendations on production readiness.     Facilitate security risk assessments and contribute expertise in threats, controls and technical impact.     Interpret security policies and frameworks, helping stakeholders apply them to specific solutions.     Represent Cybersecurity in projects and initiatives, constructively challenging proposed designs and decisions.     Improve advisory services, policies, procedures, guidelines and reusable security practices.  LocationThis position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken.Your profile You’re an experienced IT security professional with technical breadth and judgment to independently assess complex solutions. A strong understanding of risk and compliance enables you to balance security requirements with business needs and apply policies pragmatically. Your background includes     Several years of experience in security architecture, technical security assessments or security risk assessments.     A relevant university degree or the equivalent knowledge.      Practical experience assessing Azure, Microsoft 365 or other key infrastructure platforms.     Knowledge of cloud and SaaS security, identity and access management, and data protection.     Working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls.     The ability to document and communicate risks, control gaps and the reasoning behind your recommendations.     Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Swedish is beneficial. Experience from a large, complex enterprise environment is beneficial, as is  M&A integrations, APIs, application permissions, endpoint or network security. Familiarity with ISO 42001 and AI security is also valuable, and certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA, SC-100, AZ-500 or equivalent are considered an advantage. Clear communication and a collaborative approach help you build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious and pragmatic, you quickly understand unfamiliar technologies, translate technical issues into business risks and challenge decisions constructively. You’re comfortable taking ownership, working independently and sharing your expertise with others. The teamYou join IT Security Architecture & Advisory within Cybersecurity at Sandvik Group IT. Mainly based in Stockholm, the team consists of three experienced security advisors and four architects who support product teams, system owners, architects and projects. Together, you develop a more structured, pattern-based approach to security assurance across the solution lifecycle.Our culture At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.Contact information For further information about this position, please contact Johannes Ryberg, hiring manager, johannes.ryberg@sandvik.com  We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter. Union contacts – Sweden     Johanna Beijer, Unionen, +46 (0)70 616 18 27     Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87     Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55 Recruitment Specialist: Farzaneh Ghaderi Azar  How to apply We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible and no later than December 7th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099167.  We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

title: Djurhälsoveterinär till Bollnäs
description: Växa är ett ledande kunskapsföretag för lantbrukare med mjölk-, köttproduktion och växtodling. Genom den rådgivning och service vi säljer bidrar vi med ökad konkurrenskraft för svenskt lantbruk. Vår omsättning är drygt 560 miljoner kronor och vi har cirka 500 medarbetare fördelade på 27 driftsplatser över hela landet. Hållbarhet är centralt för oss, och våra kunder och Växa står för klimatsmart produktion och god djurhälsa. Hos Växa får du utveckling - bra förmåner och engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad för våra kunder och medlemmar, och det märks!About the WorkplaceVäxa is a leading knowledge-based company serving farmers within dairy, meat production, and crop cultivation. Through the advisory services and support we provide, we contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture. Our annual turnover exceeds SEK 560 million, and we employ approximately 500 people across 27 operational locations throughout the country. Sustainability is central to our mission, and together with our customers, Växa promotes climate‑smart production and high standards of animal health.At Växa, you will find opportunities for development, attractive benefits, and dedicated colleagues. Together, we make a meaningful difference for our customers and members — and it truly shows.1 plats(er). Djurhälsoveterinär till Bollnäs – vill du göra skillnad för både djur och lantbrukare?Vill du arbeta förebyggande med djurhälsa, ha stor frihet i vardagen och samtidigt vara en del av ett kunnigt och engagerat team? Då kanske du är vår nya kollega i Bollnäs.Som djurhälsoveterinär på Växa arbetar du nära lantbrukaren med att utveckla djurhälsa, smittskydd och en hållbar svensk mjölk- och köttproduktion. Arbetet är varierat och sker till stor del ute på gård. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter är rådgivning och besättningsbesök inom Smittsäkrad besättning (SSB) och ViLA, men också kurser, utbildning och andra insatser inom förebyggande djurhälsa.Du behöver inte kunna allt från börjanFör oss är ditt intresse för nöt, din nyfikenhet och din vilja att utvecklas minst lika viktiga som lång erfarenhet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper som förmåga att bygga relationer och skapa förtroende hos kund.Du får kollegor med stor kunskap inom djurhälsa och nötproduktion och har ett brett nätverk inom Växa att luta dig mot. Du kommer också att bli tilldelad en mentor för att snabbt komma in i arbetet.Vi vill att du ska känna att det finns någon att fråga, diskutera med och utvecklas tillsammans med.Vi tror att du    är legitimerad veterinär    har goda kunskaper i svenska    har B-körkort    tycker om att möta människor och skapa förtroende    är intresserad av nötkreatur, smittskydd och förebyggande djurhälsoarbete    vill bidra till utvecklingen av svensk animalieproduktion.Erfarenhet av SSB, ViLA eller seminarbete är meriterande, men inget krav.Därför tror vi att du kommer trivas hos ossHos Växa får du ett självständigt och flexibelt arbete med möjlighet att planera mycket av din vardag själv. Samtidigt står du aldrig ensam. Du blir en del av ett stort kunskapsföretag där kompetensutveckling och möjligheten att lära av varandra är en naturlig del av arbetet.Vi erbjuder bland annat:    flexibelt arbetsliv    individuellt anpassad kompetensutveckling    friskvårdsbidrag    sjukvårdsförsäkringDin arbetsplats blir BollnäsI Bollnäs väntar inte bara vackra Hälsingland utan också en arbetsplats med en fin sammanhållning där samarbete är det självklara arbetssättet.Arbetet innebär resor till våra kunder, så du behöver trivas både ute på gård och bakom ratten.Nyfiken?Du behöver inte bocka av varenda punkt för att höra av dig. Är du veterinär, gillar kor och vill utvecklas inom förebyggande djurhälsa vill vi gärna prata med dig. Välkommen!Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Lead
description: At Voyado we’re growing internationally, and with growth comes new opportunities, challenges, and decisions to make. That’s where you come in!We’re looking for an FP&A Lead who combines a sharp analytical mind with a strong commercial mindset. Someone who’s curious about the business behind the numbers, enjoys working with people, and isn’t afraid to challenge assumptions or bring new ideas to the table.This is a role where you’ll get the best of both worlds: taking the lead in a small team while staying close to the business and getting hands-on with the numbers yourself.Sound like your kind of challenge? Keep reading!About the roleAs our FP&A Lead, you’ll connect financial performance with what’s happening across the business.You’ll provide day-to-day leadership for a team of business controllers, setting priorities and supporting their success without formal people-management responsibilities. Working closely with stakeholders across Voyado, you’ll turn financial insights into meaningful conversations that help drive smarter business decisions.You’ll also help develop our FP&A processes and ways of working as we continue to scale. You’ll report directly to our CFO, Björn Källén.Some things you'll be up to:    Partner with the business. Work closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, challenge assumptions, and bring financial and commercial perspectives to the table.    Stay hands-on. Own financial planning, forecasting, performance follow-ups, and analysis for your business areas.    Connect the dots. Analyze SaaS metrics and business performance to identify opportunities, understand what’s driving growth, and support better decisions.    Lead by example. Guide the team’s day-to-day work, support your colleagues, and foster collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.    Challenge and improve. Help develop our FP&A processes, reporting, and tools, including exploring how automation and AI can help us work smarter.Who you areFirst things first: we’re not looking for someone who simply loves spreadsheets and financial reporting. We’re looking for someone who loves understanding a business and using numbers to make a difference.We believe you bring:    Solid experience in FP&A, business controlling, commercial finance, or a similar business-oriented finance role.    Hands-on experience in tech/B2B SaaS, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue models and key metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, and customer economics.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial data into actionable business insights.    A commercial mindset and experience working closely with stakeholders to influence business decisions.    Experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.    The ability to guide and support others, bring people together, and create structure and momentum in a team.    Professional fluency in English.Experience leading or coordinating others is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take initiative, bring people together, and lead by example.Your background doesn’t have to follow the traditional finance path. What matters is that you understand the commercial side, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn insights into action.High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.You’ll join a growing international SaaS company where finance plays an important role in shaping the business.You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. With plenty of room to challenge existing ways of working, bring new ideas, and influence how we grow, this is a role where your contribution will truly matter.And of course, we want you to enjoy the journey along the way!Some of our benefits:    30 days of vacation    Wellness allowance    Personal development opportunities    Summits and team activities    Four days from the office and one day from homeAbout VoyadoVoyado is the agentic OS for retail. AI is only as good as what it knows about the business, so Voyado brings customer, product, order, and behavioral data together in one connected system, creating the context retail runs on. With retail intelligence and agentic reasoning on top, AI agents use that single source of truth to make informed decisions and act across the full customer journey.By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.Ready to make an impact?Fantastic! 🎉Applying is easy — just upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.Additional informationAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.Making it personal with AIWe believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

title: Product Cost Specialist to Axis Communications
description: If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist.About the roleWho is your future team?Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.Who are we looking for/Who are you?We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.Work tasks    Be responsible for analyzing, negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.    Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.    Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.    Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.    Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.    Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.    Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.The position will mean some travels abroad.We are looking for    A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.    2-5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience, preferably from international manufacturing companies.    Experience working with RFQs, cost breakdowns, and supplier negotiations.    Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.    Advanced Excel skills and good MS Office skills.    Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.Other information    Start: As soon as possible.    Scope: Full-time.    Location: Lund, and some international travel may be required.    About the assignment: You will be employed by Academic Work on a consulting assignment until the end of September 2027. If both parties are satisfied with the collaboration, there is a  possibility of being hired directly by Axis thereafter.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description: As a Senior Solutions Engineer in the Nordics Field Engineering team, you will use your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform can help customers solve their complex data challenges. You’ll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team who values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customised solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward.The impact you will have:    Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory to provide technical and business value in collaboration with an Account Executive and a senior Solutions Architect.    Gain excitement from clients about Databricks through hands-on evaluation and Spark programming, integrating with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications.    Contribute to building the Databricks technical community through engagement at workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.    Become a Big Data Analytics advisor on aspects of architecture and design.    Support your customers by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications.    Develop both technically and in the pre-sales aspect with the goal of becoming an independently operating Solutions Architect.What we look for:• Familiarity working with clients, creating a narrative, answering customer questions, aligning the agenda with important interests, and achieving tangible outcomes.• Ability to independently deliver a technical proposition, identify customers’ pain-points, and explain important areas for business value to develop a trusted advisor skillset.• Code in a core programming language such as Python• Knowledgeable in a core Big Data Analytics domain with some exposure to advanced proofs-of-concept and an understanding of a major public cloud platform.• Experience diving deeper into solution architecture and Data Engineering.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleTo support our growing scale, we are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will help design, operate, and evolve our private cloud platform built on OpenStack and Ceph.You will work on large-scale infrastructure challenges across compute, storage, and networking — ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and scalable. This includes improving automation, troubleshooting complex platform issues, and continuously optimizing the cloud environment to support our internal services and development workloads.Our work is highly collaborative. You will primarily work alongside other infrastructure teams such as database, networking, and platform engineers, while also supporting software teams when investigating infrastructure-related issues and performance bottlenecks.We value engineers who are curious, pragmatic, and driven to improve systems through automation and operational excellence. title: Affärsadministratör - Ragn-Sells Recyclables
description: Vill du göra riktig skillnad varje dag? På Ragn-Sells är det exakt det vi gör, oavsett vilken position du har. Vi är ett familjeföretag i tredje generationen med erfarenheten i ryggen och blicken mot morgondagens innovationer. Vi erbjuder dig    Arbete inom en av Sveriges viktigaste branscher    En trevlig arbetsplats med bra och kunniga kollegor    Självklart goda anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, pension, friskvårdsbidrag osv.    Kompetensutvecklingsmöjligheter genom vår egen Akademi ArbetsuppgifterSom Affärsadministratör ansvarar du för den löpande affärsadministrationen och bidrar till att våra administrativa flöden fungerar effektivt och med hög kvalitet. I arbetet ingår bland annat kund- och orderadministration, fakturering, registervård samt hantering och uppföljning av fakturareklamationer.Du har många kontaktytor och samarbetar nära med kunder, försäljning, logistik och produktion. Du bidrar också till att utveckla och effektivisera våra administrativa arbetssätt. Din profil Vi söker dig som har gymnasieutbildning, gärna inom ekonomi, och erfarenhet av administrativt arbete. Du har god systemvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem, gärna Microsoft Dynamics 365 eller motsvarande. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska. Erfarenhet av affärs- eller försäljningsadministration samt återvinningsbranschen är meriterande.För vem passar den här tjänsten?Tjänsten passar dig som är strukturerad, noggrann och serviceinriktad och som trivs med många kontaktytor. Du arbetar självständigt, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och har lätt för att samarbeta. Du är lösningsorienterad och kan prioritera när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras. AnsökanVi arbetar med löpande urval och kan därmed komma att tillsätta tjänsten före sista ansökningsdatum som är 2026-12-23. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta Christian Gauffin på mailto:christian.gauffin@ragnsells.com.Välkommen med din ansökan!   Ragn-Sells is a privately held corporate group operating companies in six countries. Since 1966, we have been involved in waste management, environmental services and recycling. We collect, treat and recycle waste and residual products from businesses, organizations and households. Our 2,500 employees include specialists in many areas – from treatment experts who design and operate materials centers to experts on hazardous waste, sanitation and sorting. To complement our regular operations, we also provide consulting services with specialists on chemicals, energy and the environment. As a result of the continuous work to improve our services, Ragn-Sells has established Recyclables - an organization responsible for trading of raw materials in the six RS-countries. Recyclables is formed as a subsidiary company under the parent Ragn-Sellsföretagen AB.

title: Software Developer

title: Global Key Customer Manager
description: Company description:At Epiroc, we collaborate with some of the world’s leading mining companies to address these challenges. We are now looking for a Global Key Account Manager who wants to contribute to developing these long-term partnerships and creating value for both our customers and Epiroc. This is a role for someone with a deep understanding of the mining industry who thrives at the intersection of people, technology, operational development, and business. You see the bigger picture of a mining operation and are motivated by building collaborations that make a real difference over time.Job description:Your missionAs a Global Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and driving collaboration with some of Epiroc’s most strategically important global customers.You will work closely with both customer leadership teams and operational stakeholders, as well as colleagues across Epiroc, to identify opportunities, develop joint strategies, and ensure long-term growth for both parties.The role includes, among other things:     Develop and implement global account strategies for selected key customers.     Build long-term trust through presence, understanding, and strategic partnership.     Identify business opportunities within equipment, aftermarket services, automation, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Coordinate customer activities across regions, divisions, and functions within Epiroc.     Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customer challenges and translating them into value-creating solutions.     Drive growth through both existing business and new business opportunities.     Ensure close collaboration between customer organizations and Epiroc’s global organization.     Develop a deep understanding of customers’ strategic priorities and future challenges.     Coordinate resources and expertise from different parts of Epiroc’s organization to meet customer needs.     Identify opportunities where Epiroc and the customer can create greater value together.     Contribute to the development of future solutions within automation, electrification, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Ensure customer perspectives and needs are translated into concrete initiatives within Epiroc. Your profile We believe you have experience from the mining industry or a related industrial environment and a strong understanding of customers’ day-to-day operations, challenges, and long-term objectives. You understand the interplay between production, technology, maintenance, safety, and business performance.You may, for example, have worked as:     Mine Manager     Production Manager     Mining Engineering Manager or Mining Engineer     Mining Industry Consultant     Site Manager     Technical Services Manager     Mine Planning Manager or Engineer The most important thing is not your current title, but that you understand how value is created in the mining industry and can translate that understanding into strong, long-term business relationships.We would like you to have:     Solid experience from the mining industry.     A strong understanding of operational and strategic mining challenges.     Experience working across multiple functions and stakeholders.     The ability to create engagement and collaboration across organizational boundaries.     Strong communication skills and experience building relationships at both operational and strategic levels.     A genuine interest in people, technology, and business development.     Excellent English language skills. To thrive in this role, we believe you:     Are curious about how the mining industry is evolving.     Have a strong interest in both technology and business.     Are proactive, with a focus on results and long-term value creation.     Are skilled at creating engagement and fostering collaboration.     Are comfortable working in international environments and across different cultures.     Enjoy building relationships and earning trust over time.     See opportunities where others see complexity.     Have a strong holistic perspective and understand both operations and business.     Enjoy bringing people together around shared goals. Location and otherThis position can be in Örebro or Stockholm, Sweden. Other locations with proximity to Epiroc offices could also be discussed.Travel is required. We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:     Global career opportunities     Learning & Development programs     Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)     Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being     Global Parental Leave Policy Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 6. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager, Lars Bergkvist, lars.bergkvist@epiroc.comRecruitment specialist, Martin Liljeholm, martin.liljeholm@external.epiroc.com

title: OFCI Manager
description: Why RLB? This role ensures the timely, on-budget delivery of projects that meet client expectations and stakeholder satisfaction. The OFCI Project Manager will oversee the design, fabrication, inspection, approval, installation, commissioning, and handover of critical plant and equipment on behalf of the client and the project team.The ideal candidate will have a mechanical or electrical background and will be responsible for monitoring day-to-day activities in the field. This includes managing and coordinating information flow, as well as reporting and tracking issues related to progress, quality, and safety. The role will also require client-facing communication with proven organizational and interpersonal skills.Role Responsibilities:    Assist in the delivery of a wide range of projects.    Engage with vendors to identify project risks and ensure these risks are assessed and managed throughout the design, fabrication, and installation stages.    Review technical submissions from vendors and/or contractors to ensure compliance with the client's specifications.    Prepare for and facilitate meetings, ensuring all minutes are recorded.    Attend meetings, monitor progress, and escalate any issues that may arise.    Implement project procedures and ensure they are consistently followed.    Assist with the change management process.    Support the implementation of key project processes to ensure successful project delivery, and monitor these processes while reporting and making recommendations to the client team.    Conduct regular site walks to promote safety and monitor progress; report and track corrective actions through to completion.    Regularly inspect the site, obtain progress and quality reports, and ensure non-conforming work is addressed.    Assist in the review and assessment of proposed variations and any delays to project progress.    Support the development of the handover plan, track documentation preparation, and coordinate snagging activities with the client, consultant, and contractor teams.    Work closely with the client's vendors to ensure timely delivery and installation of critical project equipment. This includes equipment like Generators, MV Switchgear, LV Switchgear, BAS, EPMS, AHUs, UPS, etc.    Align the Vendor Equipment Schedule with the overall project timeline in collaboration with the Lead Project Manager and client.    Engage with vendors early in the manufacturing process and align factory witness tests with project milestones.    Work with the appointed General Contractor (GC) and specialist subcontractors to ensure correct work methods and installation requirements are followed. title: DESIGN QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER
description: At Permobil, we innovate for individuals, developing advanced assistive solutions that enrich the lives of adults and children living with disabilities. Our users come first, and we combine technology, clinical insights, and continuous improvement to create safe, effective, and trusted products. Join an international team where your expertise helps deliver life-changing technology. About the role As a Design Quality Assurance Engineer, you will help embed quality, safety, and regulatory compliance throughout product development - from concept to commercialization and lifecycle management. Working within cross-functional Agile Innovation teams, you will partner with Engineering, Product Owners, System Architects, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure robust design controls, risk management, verification and validation, and documentation. Key responsibilities     Execute design assurance activities in accordance with QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, ISO 14971, and other applicable requirements,     Support the creation, maintenance, and organization of Design History Files (DHF) and Medical Device Files (MDF),     Develop and review clear, testable, traceable requirements based on user needs, intended use, and risk analysis,    Ensure robust design inputs, outputs, verification, and validation, providing guidance on test strategies, sampling plans, and statistical analysis,    Support risk management, including hazard analyses, FMEAs, and risk control documentation,    Integrate quality into sprint planning, backlog refinement, and design reviews, maintaining traceability, change control, and design controls within Agile development,    Provide quality oversight and regulatory-grade documentation for hardware, software, and system-level development,    Support design changes, post-market updates, lifecycle management, design transfer, and commercialization,    Improve design assurance processes, risk management practices, templates, and tools. Qualifications and skills     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field,    Minimum 3 years of experience in medical device R&D, quality engineering, or design assurance,    Solid understanding of medical device regulations and design controls, including QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and ISO 14971,    Working knowledge of relevant standards, such as IEC 60601 and IEC 62304,    Experience with risk management, including FMEA and hazard analysis, and a strong foundation in statistics, sampling, verification, and validation,    Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global, regulated environment,    Experience in Agile teams and supporting both hardware and software development is an advantage. Who you are You are proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about developing safe, effective, and compliant medical devices. You combine technical expertise with a pragmatic approach, enjoy solving challenges across disciplines, and continuously seek better ways of working. Above all, you are motivated by improving the lives of people who rely on our products. Why Permobil? Make a difference, make your mark, and feel welcome. Help improve lives through evidence-based innovation, collaborate across borders, and shape the future of assistive technology alongside passionate, supportive colleagues. Join a responsible business committed to sustainability and continuous improvement. Application Selection is ongoing, so submit your application today. Permobil is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals. Position enquiries: Yousef Norouzi, Director Design Assurance yousef.norouzi@permobil.com Recruitment enquiries: Zivile Mitkute, Talent Acquisition Partner zivile.mitkute@permobil.com We respectfully decline recruitment and advertising services. About Permobil Founded on Dr. Per Uddén’s belief that independence is a basic human right, Permobil has advanced rehabilitation technology for over 50 years. Our solutions include power and manual wheelchairs, seating and positioning products, and power assist. Headquartered in Sweden, Permobil is part of Patricia Industries, a subsidiary of Investor AB, with 2,000 team members across 18 countries. Learn more at permobil.com.

title: Statistical Programming Strategy & Portfolio Lead, Associate Director
description: Are you an experienced Statistical Programming professional with deep knowledge of clinical drug development? Would you like to use your technical expertise to provide strategic programming leadership and help shape the delivery of clinical development programmes? Join us at AstraZeneca CVRM (Cardiovascular Renal Metabolism) Biometrics to impact a wide range of engaging projects striving to make a difference for millions of patients. Our Biometrics team consists of Statisticians, Programmers, Information and Data Scientists. We drive and contribute to optimized clinical drug development programs and access to information and scientific knowledge management. We are now offering an exciting opportunity for a dedicated and highly motivated individual to join us as Statistical Programming, Associate Director, providing strategic programming leadership within CVRM Biometrics and collaborating with global product development teams.This role is primarily focused on strategic and technical leadership, planning and project management rather than hands-on statistical programming. You will draw on your technical programming expertise to provide direction, oversee delivery and support high-quality decision-making.This role will be placed at AstraZeneca's dynamic R&D strategic site in Gothenburg (Sweden), where you will work in an international environment at the forefront of clinical development. Accountabilities:As a Statistical Programming, Associate Director, you are accountable for quality, timely and efficient delivery of project programming work and information management. This position requires profound programming experience and excellent industry knowledge to provide strategic and technical leadership across programming activities, including planning and project management. This is a strategic leadership role with project and technical focus where you will provide subject matter expertise within the statistical programming discipline. You will oversee the delivery of data according to industry standards, and high-quality statistical analyses and reporting deliverables, as well as planning and execution of submission strategies. You will act as a specialist within cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, innovation, and automation solutions. Essential Skills/Experience:    Degree in Mathematics (e.g., Applied Math, Engineering, etc.), Statistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or equivalent experience    Advanced knowledge of the clinical development process and industry standards    Demonstrated programming leadership capability, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction, develop teams and individuals, and lead them towards a common goal without formal line management responsibility    Demonstrated influencing, planning and organizational skills    Ability to provide input to functional strategies    Expertise in risk management in complex or novel situations    Strong technical experience in SAS and CDISC standards, together with current knowledge and awareness of regulatory requirements relevant to Statistical Programming Desirable Skills/Experience:    Broad experience, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas and/or beyond Statistical Programming    Experience in regulatory submissions and regulatory interactions    Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing business processes    Willingness and ability to travel At AstraZeneca, we believe in the potential of our people, and you'll develop beyond what you thought possible. We make the most of your skills and passion by actively supporting you to see what you can achieve no matter where you start with us. In this role, you'll play a pivotal role in channeling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients' lives and join us on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.This role is an office-based role with some degree of flexibility. Our vibrant office sites provide a diverse and collaborative work environment, where interactions lead to ideas and innovations, giving you and others the perfect opportunity to learn, grow and develop careers. Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have a seat available, and we hope it's yours. Apply today! Welcome with your application no later than December 6th, 2026.

title: Front-end Developer to Swedbank’s Group AI Accelerator
description: Do you have a passion for creating modern, intuitive and accessible digital experiences, and want to advance AI capabilities at a leading bank in the Nordics and Baltics?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:    Design, develop, test and continuously improve modern applications using Angular and TypeScript, including accessible and responsive AI-powered experiences across web and mobile channels.    Translate business needs and UX/UI designs into scalable, high-performing solutions, collaborating with designers, product owners, platform engineers and backend developers.    Integrate frontend applications with APIs, backend services and AI capabilities.    Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, code reviews, automated testing, secure development, performance optimization and accessibility standards.    Take ownership from implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement, while contributing to CI/CD, documentation and knowledge sharing.    Collaborate closely with data engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions    Ensure solutions are built with security, compliance, and governance in mind.    Continuously develop your skills through mentorship, training and workshops and by working on diverse projects that push technological boundaries.    Be part of an innovative team that values creativity, diversity, inclusion, and fosters an environment where new ideas are encouraged. What is needed in this role:    Proven experience with Angular, TypeScript, HTML and CSS, together with strong knowledge of responsive design, WCAG accessibility and user-centered design.    Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and applying best practices for automated testing, code quality, performance, maintainability and security.    Experience with conversational or AI-driven user experiences. Familiarity with AI chatbots, RAG, prompt engineering, agent-based patterns and AGUI is valuable.    A full-stack mindset, with working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot or Python and FastAPI, plus experience with cloud-native development on Microsoft Azure.    Familiarity with Git, GitHub, CI/CD and observability tools such as Grafana, Loki and Mimir, and experience working in Agile cross-functional teams.    A growth mindset — motivated to explore frontier AI developments, stay updated on AI trends, and apply learnings to real-world challenges.    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in English, with enthusiasm to work in a team environment.    Experience from the banking or financial services sector is beneficial.    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. With us, you can experience:    Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.    Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.    An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.    A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.    Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden."Join our team and...become part of Group AI Accelerator, an international and cross-functional team combining frontend excellence, AI enablement and platform innovation. Together, we create intuitive, accessible and secure digital experiences that contribute to Swedbank’s digital transformation and position in society." -Emelie Gustavsson, your future manager We look forward to receiving your application by 04.12.2026. Location: Umeå or StockholmRecruiting manager: Emelie Gustavsson +46725394117 We may begin the selection during the application period, so we welcome your application as soon as possible.We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.

title: Breast and Melanoma Surgeon Opportunity at a Leading University Hospital
description: Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!Are you a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a particular interest in breast and melanoma surgery? Are you looking for an opportunity to develop further within specialised cancer surgery while working in a multidisciplinary and academically active environment?We are currently recruiting a Specialist in General Surgery with experience and a strong professional interest in breast and melanoma surgery for a permanent position at a major university hospital in southwestern Sweden.The position offers the opportunity to combine specialised clinical work with multidisciplinary cancer care, professional development, teaching and research in a highly specialised hospital environment.About the positionYour primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.Breast and melanoma surgeryThe position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.A university hospital environmentThe hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.Who are we looking for?We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.QualificationsWe are looking for a candidate who:    Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery    Has relevant clinical experience    Has experience and a strong professional interest in breast surgery, melanoma surgery and/or related oncological surgery    Is comfortable managing patients throughout different stages of the surgical care pathway    Enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multiprofessional teams    Has a strong sense of responsibility and an interest in clinical development    Has good communication and collaboration skills    Has good English language skills    Is strongly motivated to learn Swedish and establish a long-term career in SwedenFor candidates who do not yet speak Swedish, language training is provided as part of the recruitment process.What the hospital offersYou will have the opportunity to:    Work within specialised breast and melanoma surgery    Develop your competence within surgical cancer care    Work with both outpatient consultations and surgical treatment    Become part of an established multidisciplinary cancer care environment    Participate in teaching and continuous clinical development    Work in a research-intensive university hospital environment    Collaborate with experienced specialists across different medical and surgical disciplines    Continue developing both clinically and academicallyWhat Dignus Medical offers you:• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:Interested?We look forward to hearing from you!You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Son développement constant repose sur une approche alliant excellence technique, proximité avec les clients et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques et innovantes. **Votre rôle**En tant que Chef·fe de Projet, vous prenez la responsabilité de mandats de structures depuis les premières phases d'étude jusqu'à la réalisation des ouvrages.Vous intervenez comme interlocuteur privilégié des maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes et partenaires du projet. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants, assurez le suivi technique et financier des affaires et veillez au respect des objectifs de qualité, de coûts et de délais.Votre expertise vous permet d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée dans les choix techniques et les orientations constructives, tout en garantissant la faisabilité et la cohérence globale des projets. **Vos responsabilités**Vous pilotez les études de conception et participez activement au développement des solutions techniques les plus adaptées aux contraintes des projets.Vous coordonnez les équipes de projet, assurez le suivi des prestations et veillez à la bonne circulation des informations entre les différents intervenants.Vous supervisez les calculs, les modélisations et la production des documents techniques nécessaires à l'exécution des ouvrages.Vous accompagnez les clients et partenaires tout au long du projet, en leur apportant des conseils techniques pertinents et une vision claire des enjeux.Vous participez aux séances de coordination et assurez le suivi des travaux afin de garantir la conformité des réalisations aux exigences définies.Enfin, vous contribuez au développement du bureau par la qualité de vos réalisations et la confiance que vous instaurez avec vos interlocuteurs. **Ce que vous rejoignez*** Un bureau d'ingénieurs reconnu pour la qualité de ses réalisations  * Des projets variés et techniquement stimulants  * Une structure à taille humaine favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative  * Une collaboration étroite avec des architectes, maîtres d'ouvrage et partenaires de premier plan  * Des conditions de travail attractives : semaine de 4,5 jours, télétravail, flexibilité horaire et 6 semaines de vacances  * Ferrucci*** Ferrucci**jidf335187jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Vous disposez également de bonnes connaissances en mécanique automobile et/ou véhicules utilitaires.  * Vous maîtrisez le diagnostic de pannes et êtes à l’aise avec les environnements associant mécanique, froid, électricité et électronique.  *    + Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances informatiques et êtes à l’aise avec les outils de diagnostic, les logiciels de gestion d’atelier ainsi que les outils bureautiques nécessaires au suivi de l’activité.      + Autonome, méthodique et réactif(ve), vous savez organiser les priorités, anticiper les besoins et trouver des solutions face aux imprévus.      + Une première expérience dans la coordination d’une équipe ou l’organisation d’un atelier constitue un atout.      + Vous êtes titulaire d’un permis de conduire valable.        **Nous vous offrons :**    + Un environnement de travail convivial, dynamique et motivé      + Poste basé à Yverdon\-les\-Bains      + 5 semaines de congés      + Des prestations sociales attractives      + Entreprise certifiée Great Place to Work      + Une politique de formation continue innovante       Entrée en fonction : à convenir   **Candidatures acceptées uniquement via Jobup**    ![Fraikin Suisse SA]()*** ![Fraikin Suisse SA]()***jida5ef12bjm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Storage & Data Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Storage &amp; Data Engineer--- Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================**The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS)** develops and operates a high\-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world\-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.For this position the work location is either Lugano or Zürich. The contract is for two years.Project background------------------Storing petabytes is the easy part. The hard part is everything between the moment data lands on disk and the moment a researcher — or a training job — can actually trust it, find it, and use it.  Our parallel filesystems and object stores already move data fast. What they don't do on their own is tell a scientist where a dataset came from, which transformations produced it, whether it's the version that backed last quarter's published result, or how to feed it to a DataLoader without saturating the I/O subsystem. That gap — between raw bytes and usable, traceable, reproducible data — is where this role lives.  You'll work at both ends: the storage layer (throughput, integrity, tiering at multi\-petabyte scale) and the data layer above it (lineage, provenance, discoverability, access patterns). If you've ever been annoyed that *"the data is on the cluster"* gets treated as the end of the job rather than the start of it, read on.description-----------* **Bridge ingestion and use.** Design the pipelines and metadata that turn ingested data into something findable and consumable — catalogs, schemas, and access layers that match how training jobs and simulations actually read, not just where bytes sit.* **Make data traceable.** Build lineage and provenance so any dataset, checkpoint, or result can be traced back to its inputs and transformations. Reproducibility is a first\-class requirement here, not a retrofit.* **Tune for the workload.** Optimise parallel filesystems (Lustre, GPFS) and object storage for the concurrency, small\-file, and large\-checkpoint patterns of distributed GPU training and HPC simulation.* **Operate at scale, safely.** Design and run multi\-petabyte storage with the integrity and availability scientific work depends on — erasure coding, redundancy, hot\-to\-archival tiering.* **Automate everything.** Deploy and scale storage and data services as code. Snowflake infrastructure doesn't survive at this scale.* **Make it observable.** Instrument storage health, capacity trends, and pipeline performance so problems surface before users feel them.* **Translate.** Turn real access patterns from domain scientists and ML engineers into technical requirements — and push back when a request would quietly break something downstream.For a project in the weather and climate domain, aimed at understanding and mitigating the impact of climate change, an opening for **two years** is available.The initial two\-year contract could potentially be extended or even become permanent.Profile-------* A technical degree (CS, engineering) **or** equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth.* Solid storage grounding: filesystems (block and object), performance tuning, redundancy (RAID, erasure coding).* , and comfort automating infrastructure (Ansible, Terraform, or similar).* A working understanding of how ML and scientific workloads consume data — billions of small files, large checkpoints, sharding — and why naive layouts fall over.* A point of view on data lineage, provenance, or reproducibility — and ideally tooling you've used to enforce it.**What helps you stand out*** Hands\-on parallel filesystems (Lustre, Spectrum Scale/GPFS) or distributed storage (Ceph, VAST).* Scientific data formats — HDF5, Zarr, Parquet — and opinions on when each earns its place.* Object storage (S3\) interfaced with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).* Orchestration (Kubernetes, Argo) and data\-movement tooling.* Data versioning / cataloguing (e.g. DVC, lakeFS, a metadata catalog) and familiarity with FAIR data principles.* CI/CD and provisioning: GitLab CI, HashiCorp Vault, MAAS.We don't expect every box ticked. Depth in storage *or* data engineering, plus the curiosity to grow into the other, matters more than a complete checklist.**What you get*** Hardware and scale you won't find in enterprise IT — and problems with no vendor playbook.* Work that directly enables published science and frontier\-scale model training.* Room to shape how data is *managed*, not just maintained, in an environment that takes it seriously.**Our core values as guiding principles:*** Curiosity: You enjoy learning and understanding systems deeply* Openness: You collaborate effectively and value different perspectives* Courage: You are willing to tackle difficult or unfamiliar problems* Supportive: You help colleagues and users succeed* Integrity: You act responsibly, reliably, and transparentlyWe offer--------We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically adept, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.* Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society* You can expect , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the , and attractive* You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.* We value the diversity of our team and, to further enhance the diversity of our workforce, we particularly encourage women to apply.We value diversity and sustainability-------------------------------------In line with , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a .Curious? So are we.-------------------Please include the following documents with your application:* Motivation letter in pdf* CV in pdf* Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf formatWe look forward to receiving your online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, and employment certificates. Please address your application to Mrs Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.Further information about CSCS can be found on our . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Pim Witlox, witlox@ (no applications).For recruitment services, the apply.About ETH Zürich-----------------ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting\-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid7d6273ajm jit1147jm jiy26jm
